title: Conditions of the Private Event & Banquet Services Agreement
content:
An event services agreement under Private Event & Banquet Services is drawn up against one venue and one event package, and booking does not open until the agreement is countersigned.

## Clause 1 — the states in which an agreement is opened or activated

An agreement is only opened or activated while it stands proposed or already active, and a proposal that is withdrawn before countersignature closes without charge. The state relied on is the state the company's own records show against that agreement before the agreement is opened or activated, read against the agreement's own reference, and not the client's account of where the paperwork has got to.

| The records show the agreement | Opened or activated |
| --- | --- |
| Proposed | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| On hold | No |
| Closed | No |

## Clause 2 — signature and insurance

Packages above the meeting room package require a signed agreement on file, and packages from the conference day package upward require a certificate of event insurance before any event is held, though not before the agreement is activated.

## Clause 3 — the package sets the whole column

The package the agreement is written against sets the whole parameter column that every booking under it takes — minimum spend, room rental, deposits, guarantee deadline, cancellation ladder and payment terms together.

## Clause 4 — the package the agreement is written at

Where the client's expected number of events a year does not reach the minimum printed against the package applied for, the agreement is written at the highest package whose minimum the client does meet.

## Clause 5 — a client holding two venues

A client may hold agreements at two venues on different packages, and a booking always takes the package of the agreement its venue sits under rather than the client's best package.

## Illustration on hypothetical circumstances

A client applying for a package whose minimum is 6 events a year but expecting 4 is written at the highest package whose minimum is met by 4. The same client holding a second agreement at another venue on a different package takes that second package's guarantee deadline and cancellation ladder for events at that venue, whichever package is the better of the two.
